parts.text: Lancet arch model This arch is made using two equal arcs. The equal arcs are parts of the circumferences of two identical circles both of radius r metres. The base of the arch is on the line joining the centres of the two circles. The height is on the line of symmetry of the arch.

content.tex: This arch is made using two equal arcs.

The equal arcs are parts of the circumferences of two identical circles both of radius \(r\) metres. The base of the arch is on the line joining the centres of the two circles. The height is on the line of symmetry of the arch.
